resolution_notes.3x: 3x for high-density displays (iPhone Plus/XR, Android xxhdpi/xxxhdpi)

logo.description: My Team Baseball game logo with baseball character and text

files.usage: App icon, splash screen, main menu logo
files.notes: Full-color logo. Resize to 512x512 for 2x, 256x256 for 1x. Crop to 1024x1024 for app icon.

sprites.description: Player character sprites in batting stance, pitching, fielding, and running poses
sprites.notes: Base resolution 512x1024 (2x). 1x = 256x512, 3x = 768x1536. All PNG with transparent backgrounds.

files.usage: Batter character sprite - batting stance with bat over shoulder
files.notes: Front-facing batter. Resize to 512x768 for 2x, 256x384 for 1x.

files.usage: Pitcher character sprite - mid-windup pitching motion
files.notes: Side-facing pitcher in windup. Resize to 512x768 for 2x, 256x384 for 1x.

files.usage: Fielder character sprite - crouched fielding position with glove
files.notes: Front-facing fielder in ready position. Resize to 512x768 for 2x, 256x384 for 1x.

files.usage: Base runner character sprite - sprinting motion
files.notes: Side-facing runner sprinting. Resize to 512x768 for 2x, 256x384 for 1x.

field.description: Baseball field background from top-down view

files.usage: Game field background - top-down view with bases, mound, fence
files.notes: Square aspect ratio. Can be scaled to fit screen. 1x=512x512, 2x=1024x1024, 3x=1536x1536.

jerseys.description: Blank jersey templates for team customization
jerseys.notes: These are template shapes. The game engine should colorize/recolor these programmatically with team colors and overlay numbers/logos.

files.usage: Blank front-facing jersey template for team color/logo customization
files.notes: Base for team jersey customization. Overlay team colors and numbers programmatically. 1x=256x256, 2x=512x512, 3x=768x768.

files.usage: Blank back-facing jersey template for team color/number customization
files.notes: Base for back of jersey. Overlay player number programmatically. 1x=256x256, 2x=512x512, 3x=768x768.

ui.description: UI elements for menus, buttons, scoreboard, and cards

files.usage: Main PLAY button for home screen
files.notes: Green circular button with PLAY text. 1x=128x128, 2x=256x256, 3x=384x384.

files.usage: Scoreboard overlay during gameplay - shows innings, runs, hits, errors
files.notes: Wide aspect ratio for top of screen. 1x=768x512, 2x=1536x1024, 3x=2304x1536.

files.usage: Main menu background scene - baseball field at sunset
files.notes: Portrait aspect ratio for mobile menu. 1x=512x768, 2x=1024x1536, 3x=1536x2304.

files.usage: Player stat card UI element - batting avg, HR, RBI, ERA
Team roster screen mockup showing player list with numbers and positions
files.notes: Reference mockup for the roster screen layout. 1x=512x768, 2x=1024x1536.

files.usage: Settings gear icon button for toolbar
Small baseball icon for use in menus, buttons, stat displays

app_icon.description: Mobile app icon for iOS and Android

files.usage: Primary app icon - smiling baseball with cap and bat on blue background
files.notes: iOS: 1024x1024 (App Store), Android: 512x512 (Play Store), 192x192 (adaptive icon), 48x48 (mdpi). Resize as needed.

splash.description: Splash screen shown on app launch

files.usage: App launch/splash screen - baseball field scene with logo text
files.notes: Portrait mobile aspect ratio. iOS: 1242x2208 (iPhone 6/7/8 Plus), Android: based on device. Scale as needed.

fonts.headings: Bold rounded sans-serif (e.g., Fredoka One, Nunito ExtraBold)
fonts.numbers: Monospace or sports-style numbers (e.g., Bebas Neue, Oswald)
